about: Question bank for the Ask (chat) mode — every question TYPE the app is built to answer, with example phrasings. Used three ways: (1) the spec of what a good answer contains ('answer'); (2) chat_router matches unfamiliar phrasings against these examples (nearest example wins), so adding a phrasing here teaches the app that phrasing — no code change; (3) tests check every example is understood. Placeholders in {braces} are filled from 'slots' (a type can override them). 'expect' = what the parser must produce: mode, acceptable primary topics, the question's form.

forms.yes_no: Is/does/can … ? — answer with a verdict first (yes / no / possibly / not stated), then the evidence.
forms.how_long: A duration — half-life, onset, how long it lasts or stays in the body.
forms.how_often: A frequency — every N hours, once daily.
forms.how_common: A likelihood — incidence of a side effect.
forms.why: A reason — the sentences that explain the link.
forms.how: A process — mechanism, how it is taken/made/cleared.
forms.which: A choice between options — comparison, no single 'best'.
forms.list: Several items — side effects, brands, drugs in a class.
forms.statement: No question words — a bare name or a statement ('I took too much X').
